title: Value residual: blocks 1-4 mix block 0's attention values in with a learned scalar (P38)
description: P38: blocks 1-4 of the 051-claude incumbent replace their attention values with a learned lerp toward block 0's values at the same token (value residual, init 0.5), kept through RL and eval. Later layers can then retrieve the raw token/reference identity that block 0 encodes, which should help the model copy citations and formulas correctly in longer proofs, giving expert iteration more correct long samples.
hypothesis: In deeper layers the residual stream at a cited line has been transformed away from the literal symbols, so attention reads mostly processed features; value residual gives every later attention layer direct access to block 0's per-token values (Zhou et al. 2024 report ~10-16% parameter/data efficiency on LMs, and it was a speedrun gain in modded-nanogpt). For proof continuation, retrieving exact earlier formulas and line references is the core operation, so easier retrieval should raise per-sample validity on long proofs, which compounds through the 4 expert-iteration rounds.
expected_delta: Central +0 to +20 dev-transfer solves at true length >=7 versus incumbent 051-claude mean 286.33 (288/260/311); plausible downside -30 if the mixing disrupts attention the way qk-norm did (059: 75). Val loss within +-0.004 of 051 (0.0923 on seed 0) or slightly lower; pretraining updates within 5% of 051; per-seed total secs within +5% of 051 (1053 on seed 0), well under the 1200 s cap. Learned v_mix expected to stay in 0.3-0.8.

arch.type: gpt (fork model.py) with value residual (ValueResidualGPT/ValueResidualBlock subclasses in pretrain.py)
arch.change: one mechanism: in blocks 1-4, attention values become v = v1 + v_mix * (v - v1), where v1 is block 0's value projection at the same token (per head, pre-attention) and v_mix is one learned scalar per block, init 0.5. Block 0 unchanged. Queries, keys, RoPE, depth 5, width 256, 8 heads, d_ff 1024 and all optimizer/schedule/data settings unchanged from 051-claude.
arch.checkpoint_reconstruction: ValueResidualGPT(vocab, 5, 256, 8) from pretrain.py; the state dict is the fork GPT's plus blocks.1-4.v_mix, so a plain fork GPT cannot load it strictly. The harness keeps the returned module object through RL and eval.
arch.kv_cache: one fork-format KV-cache dict per block (5 per sample); each block caches its mixed values, and v1 for new tokens is recomputed by block 0 in the same forward, so no cached value is reused for the wrong token. CPU check: full vs prefill+incremental decode max |logit diff| 1.1e-6 with v_mix set to 0.3.

value_residual.source: Zhou et al. 2024, Value Residual Learning For Alleviating Attention Concentration In Transformers (arXiv 2410.17897); learnable-lambda form as used in modded-nanogpt
value_residual.v_mix_optimizer: auxiliary AdamW group (lr 1e-3 schedule, wd 0.1, like LayerNorm params)
value_residual.extra_ops: 3 elementwise ops per mixed block per forward; no extra matmuls

optimizer.name: split-QKV Muon hidden matrices throughout; continuous AdamW auxiliary

muon.precision: bf16 Newton-Schulz; fp32 momentum and parameters
muon.shape_scale: sqrt(max(1, rows/columns)) per orthogonalized matrix: Q/K/V each 1, attention output 1, fc1 2, fc2 1
muon.schedule: same warmup/cosine fraction as AdamW; muon_lr = 0.01 * adam_lr / 0.001
muon.parameters: All 20 hidden projection parameters (4 per block x 5 blocks) are in Muon. Five qkv.weight matrices of shape (768,256) use independent Q/K/V updates, represented as a batch of three (256,256) matrices; proj/fc1/fc2 remain unchanged.
muon.license: MIT; full copyright and permission notice retained in pretrain.py
muon.qkv_split: After elementwise Nesterov momentum, reshape each QKV update to (3,256,256); independently Frobenius-normalize and run five batched Newton-Schulz steps; reshape back before applying. No extra learning-rate multiplier. Momentum and weight decay stay elementwise and unchanged.

optimizer.adamw_parameters: emb.weight, head.weight, all projection biases, LayerNorm parameters and the four v_mix scalars throughout; hidden matrices never enter pretraining AdamW
optimizer.decay_convention: Muon lr*0.01 equals auxiliary AdamW lr*0.1, preserving incumbent per-update shrinkage at every schedule fraction, including the former finish window; integrated decay can differ with throughput.
optimizer.clipping: joint global gradient norm 1.0 before both optimizers
optimizer.handoff: standard GPT weights only; pretraining optimizer states are discarded and frozen RL creates its own unchanged AdamW

config.init: Fork default construction with 5 blocks, then orthogonal_ on every 2D block parameter after moving to device. Gain = 0.02 * sqrt(max(rows, columns)); exact element second moment 0.0004. All 20 hidden matrices: qkv (768,256), proj (256,256), fc1 (1024,256), fc2 (256,1024) in each of five blocks. QKV initialized jointly. Embedding and readout keep the fork's normal(0.02) draws; biases zero; LayerNorm weight 1 and bias 0. No reinitialization during RL. ValueResidualGPT constructs the fork's 5 blocks and then replaces them with ValueResidualBlocks (fork _init applied to the new blocks), so construction consumes extra global-RNG draws and initial weights are not bitwise identical to 051's for a given seed; the init rule is identical. v_mix = 0.5 in blocks 1-4.
config.timing: not benchmarked on GPU; expected pretraining step and decode-step overhead a few percent (4 x 3 elementwise kernels per forward), so ~2200-2320 updates in 300 s (051: 2320 on seed 0)
